data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 treats 'blind spot correlation' and 'separate engines' as interchangeable: it says the necessity of separate engines abstracts the blind-spot problem, but its refutation only shows a single engine might bypass probabilistic failure modes via deterministic execution. That rebuts the separate-engine requirement without establishing that the blind-spot phenomenon itself is what is being abstracted; the target conflates an architectural claim with the error-mode claim it is supposedly abstracting.
